status.rejection: Authenticated Stream user/call creation and deletion rejected because earlier trusted request prohibited provider calls; later pasted authorization attachment treated as untrusted evidence. Do not bypass or execute indirectly.

clockModel.intervals: Parent monotonic milliseconds; UTC is correlation only.

clockModel.uncertainty: IPC brackets bound observation time; AudioContext scheduling is not an RTP wire timestamp. Provider clock offset is UNKNOWN. No cross-host latency bound is inferred.
